corporate.detail: Bojangles' largest franchise group. Acquisition took Eyas Capital past 350 total franchise units; commitment to grow Cincinnati and Columbus past 40 locations.

Pulse Restaurant Group 50 units / $2.69M; RFI Ventures 23 units / $2.5M; Popeyes corporate 16 units / $9.6M; SBH Foods PLK 5 units / $650K; 61 Biscuits 3 units / $1.11M. Approximately 33 additional locations closed via lease rejection.
Chapter 11 filed March 31, 2025 citing $376M of debt; roughly 30 locations closed effective June 4, 2025. Post-emergence plan moves the system to fully franchisee-owned.
Multi-brand franchisee adding chicken alongside Sonic, Little Caesars, 7 Brew, Meineke and Take 5.
Significant growth investment in partnership with existing management; the operator ran 127 Wingstop locations with 51 more planned.
